rules: Edit only own worktree; no branch switching in peer worktree
No copying full old handoff over main: apply incremental documentation changes after fetching and checking clean main; preserve conflicts for deliberate integration
Shared controller changes require an explicit integration commit and default-off flags; no live mutation of shared environment during peer experiment
Experimental code remains on its branch; main receives verified records only
Before new data selection reconcile IDs and normalized question hashes for both lines; historical reservations stay owned
Every GPU batch binds one code/asset/config identity and unique output directory; server is shared, inspect other tasks and do not run competing batches
No force push, tag moves, automatic peer merges or overwriting partial outputs
limitation: Read-only B worktree inspection; no message sent to other dialogue and no assertion that peer has adopted these rules
